description: Project how The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s system-wide exit fee would move if no more withdrawals happened, on Robinhood Chain. Rolls the recent withdrawal window forward day by day and reports the fee rate for each future day, plus days_until_min_fee: how many days until the fee would reach its floor under that assumption. expiry_schedule lists the exact instant each recorded withdrawal day leaves the trailing fee window (from the reserve's own day clock, not event timestamps) with the window total and fee after each one; next_fee_change_at is the first expiry that moves the fee. When incomplete_days is non-empty the schedule fields are null and only the day-by-day projection is available. This is a current-pace projection, not a prediction; the response always states its assumptions plainly. Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings; fields ending in _wad are also 18-decimal integers (the fee's own fixed-point convention). Fields come back null if the mainnet fee formula hasn't been validated live yet; check formula_version.
name: 1s_std_exit_fee_forecast
title: TSR Exit Fee Forecast
